value-1.chars: AD-2 (§7 L166, PROPOSED): satisfies if, at every zoom drawn, each heatmap row lines up with the ladder row of the same price; violates if a frame offsets the two, shows a different price step, or gives the heatmap its own price zoom control

value-2.chars: F-6 (§3 L106, Major): (heuristic) The probe "where is real support?" is answered by reading one price row across the heatmap into the ladder. If the heatmap could zoom on its own, its rows would stop lining up with the ladder's, and the read across breaks.
